name: Last lustful war
source:
This game completes the story of the confrontation between the guards and demonesses.
The main character should defeat the army of demonesses trying to seize power over the Gap.​

[From F95Zone]
translation:
本作为守卫军与女恶魔一族之间的旷日交锋画上了句号。
主角必须击败企图夺取“裂隙”统治权的女恶魔大军。

[摘自F95Zone]
